perfume.answer: China Eastern's carry-on page treats perfume as a liquid: on international and regional flights each container must hold 100 ml or less and fit in one transparent 1 L resealable bag, one bag per passenger. On domestic flights liquids are banned except self-use cosmetics, toothpaste and shaving cream.

list: Not on the page: a named rule for aerosol deodorants and hairspray. Aerosols are liquids for the cabin; flammable ones fall under dangerous goods, which China Eastern points to separate catalogues for.

faq: Can I take perfume on a China Eastern international flight?
Yes, in a container of 100 ml or less inside your one transparent 1 L bag; larger bottles must be checked.
Can I take perfume on a China Eastern domestic flight?
Liquids are not allowed in the cabin on domestic flights, except cosmetics for use during the journey that meet the one-piece, 100 ml, openable conditions.
Does duty-free perfume change on a China Eastern connection?
If you transfer to a domestic flight in the secure zone, it needs proof of purchase and a sealed intact bag; if you leave the secure area it becomes checked baggage.
